name: AMC Spotlight Grid
description: A tile grid lit by one pointer spotlight that travels across all tiles at once, revealing a dot pattern and making nearby tile edges glow, while the current tile keeps a soft resting glow.
useFor: Launchpads, module menus and settings hubs with 3 to 16 entries that each deserve a short description.
helpText: List template for a List region. Each entry is a tile with its icon, text, a description from User Defined Attribute 1 and an optional tag from Attribute 2, for example 'New' or '3 due'. The optional JavaScript file moves the spotlight with the pointer across the whole grid; without it, or on touch screens and under reduced motion, tiles light up statically on hover. Keyboard focus lights the focused tile and shows a focus ring. The current entry keeps a soft glow at rest. Template options: Intense light, Compact tiles, Rows, Night tiles.

templateOptions.name: Intense light
templateOptions.help: A larger, brighter spotlight and a thicker glowing edge.

templateOptions.name: Compact tiles
templateOptions.help: Smaller tiles with the icon beside the text; descriptions are hidden.

templateOptions.name: Rows
templateOptions.help: One full-width row per entry, for side columns and settings menus.

templateOptions.name: Night tiles
templateOptions.help: Inverts the tiles to a dark surface derived from the theme text color, where the spotlight is most visible. In a dark theme style the tiles become light.
